description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets (limite crue) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Limite de la crue de référence de la zone inondable par approche hydra; Limite de la crue de référence de la zone inondable dans la traversée ; Limite de la crue de référence de la zone inondable de la Roanne (2004; Limite de la crue de référence de la zone inondable (ZI) du bassin de . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
